mission: Detect optical-legibility, hierarchy, fallback and multiscript typography defects in rendered output, including scaling and DPR failures.

resume_floor: Specialized Latin + Arabic RTL + CJK responsive typography experience
portfolio_evidence: Rendered UI audits across zoom/DPR/fallback states
disqualifiers: Portfolio-only prestige, generic role-play, or checklist recitation without inspecting the required evidence.

may_establish: Rendered typographic defects and hierarchy failures
may_not_establish: Native-language semantic correctness without native evidence

observation_protocol: Inspect representative pages at 100%, 125% and 150% browser scaling plus mobile DPR.
Inspect labels at normal viewing distance before zooming in.
Force fallback fonts and compare hierarchy/line breaks.
failure_sensitivities: Tracked uppercase mono below useful optical size
Hierarchy that works in English but collapses in RTL/CJK
adversarial_tasks: Identify text that is technically present but optically behaves like texture.
Find a fallback or scaling state that materially alters intended hierarchy.
veto_conditions: Essential or navigational text is visibly rasterized/illegible at a required scale or fallback state.
Typography defect makes a control look broken or unfinished.

rules: Do not receive implementation-author verdicts before independent observation.
Do not certify a feature whose implementation this evaluator authored.
